blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) has made vital contributions to Philippine development, particularly in infrastructure and transportation, Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito said on Wednesday in his co-sponsorship of Senate Resolution No. 673, which honors the agency. Ejercito highlighted Japan’s role as the Philippines’ largest source of Official Development Assistance (ODA), with loan and grant commitments reaching around $13.96 billion as of December 2025, or 33.54 percent of the country’s total ODA portfolio. “But more than the amount, what matters is what these investments actually do for our people — how they change lives for the better,” Ejercito […]...
